messages.subject: adding a layer to qplot
parts:
I submitted this as a bug, but it got rejected as being part of the
design. What is the design behind this?

The first plot creates a quick plot of spatial data. Works fine.

The second adds a layer for the geographic boundaries. works just fine.

The third plot adds color and size mappings to the quick plot. This
does not work.

The fourth is what I would assume is happening behind the scenes of
qplot+layer. This works.

What It appears to me is that the x and y mappings are being retained
and correctly associated with the data dataset, but the associations
for color and size are being lost when adding a new layer since it is
looking for the color and size variables in the dataset for the new
layer.

---
library(maps)
library(ggplot2)
reg <- as.data.frame(map("county", "wyoming", plot = FALSE)[c("x", "y")])

data<-data.frame(
rx=runif(100, -111.05,-104.05), #- Longitude 104°3'W to 111°3'W
ry=runif(100,41,45), # - Latitude 41°N to 45°N
rz=rnorm(100),
rw=rnorm(100))

#works
qplot(rx,ry,col=rz, size=rw, data=data)

#works
qplot(rx,ry, data=data)+layer(data=reg, mapping = aes(x=x,y=y), geom='path')

#does not work
last_plot()+layer(data=reg, mapping = aes(x=x,y=y), geom='path')

# works
ggplot()+
layer(geom='point', data=data, mapping=aes(x=rx,y=ry,color=rz, size=rw))+
layer(geom='path', data=reg, mapping=aes(x, y))
---

what is going on here behind the scenes that I'm not understanding?

Thanks,
Andrew Redd

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: adding a layer to qplot
parts:
Hi,

do you mean like this ?

qplot(rx,ry,col=rz, size=rw, data=data)+layer(data=reg, mapping =
aes(x=x,y=y,colour=NULL, size=NULL), geom='path')

It works.

--
